_movie: pcheck.dxr: Igor's Persona check: 15 yes/no questions, then a Persona and its spell card number

ops.text: Igor: "I shall find the Persona that suits you best."

19.en: The tougher things get, the more motivated I become.

21.en: I think I have a split personality.

23.en: I can't rest unless the garbage is properly sorted.

25.en: Somehow I always end up as group leader or party organizer.

27.en: There are so many things I want to do.

29.en: When I lie, it shows on my face.

31.en: I don't find other people's opinions very useful.

33.en: People often call me "big sis" or "boss".

35.en: I'm the type who holds a grudge.

39.en: I never forget anything in a book I've read once.

41.en: I love new things but get bored quickly.

43.en: I love plotting pranks and telling tall tales.

45.en: At camps and amusement parks, I play my heart out.

47.en: I often daydream and lose track of time.

49.en: Igor: "I have found the Persona for you. Please enter its spell card number into the Evilphone."

121.en: Igor: "For you, whose mind is heightened and focused right now, I recommend the Persona WORLD Mucalinda."

123.en: Igor: "For you, who can be a little contrary, I recommend the Persona TOWER Amatsu-Mikaboshi."

125.en: Igor: "For you, a witty and playful soul, I recommend the Persona MOON Succubus."

127.en: Igor: "For you, pure, upright and noble, who hates anything crooked, I recommend the Persona HIEROPHANT Aizen-Myoh."

129.en: Igor: "For you, the strict but kind big-sister type everyone relies on, I recommend the Persona EMPRESS Vesta."

131.en: Igor: "For you, innocent as a child and full of energy, I recommend the Persona SUN Suzaku."

133.en: Igor: "For you, honest to the core and unable to lie, I recommend the Persona JUSTICE Neamhain."

135.en: Igor: "For you, who are forever seeking change, I recommend the Persona DEATH Hel."

137.en: Igor: "For you, the quiet pillar who looks after everyone, I recommend the Persona EMPEROR Seimen Kongo."

139.en: Igor: "For you, stubborn and with a craftsman's spirit, I recommend the Persona CHARIOT Ogun."

141.en: Igor: "For you, who hold limitless potential, I recommend the Persona FOOL Narukami."

143.en: Igor: "For you, a doer who can never sit still, I recommend the Persona MAGICIAN Houri."

145.en: Igor: "For you, full of affection and brimming with charm, I recommend the Persona LOVERS Pixie."

147.en: Igor: "For you, with your enigmatic, mysterious charm, I recommend the Persona PRIESTESS Mazu."

149.en: Igor: "For you, who hold to your principles in everything, I recommend the Persona DEVIL Bres."

151.en: Igor: "For you, the type who catches fire in a pinch, I recommend the Persona JUDGEMENT Nike."

153.en: Igor: "For you, the walking encyclopedia of your circle of friends, I recommend the Persona HERMIT Byakko."

155.en: Igor: "For you, who value balance and harmony in all things, I recommend the Persona TEMPERANCE Genbu."
